With Anthony, your Real Estate journey is not just a transaction; it's an adventure. Experience the Houses of Kansas City difference, where passion meets proficiency, and every deal is sealed with a touch of fun. Contact him today so he can guide you through the buying and selling process. Work with Anthony Home Search
FROM THE SITE
What "luxury" means in Kansas City
Luxury real estate here isn't just a price point. It's homes with real architectural character, properties with history, land with development potential, and buyers and sellers who want an agent who understands what makes a property actually stand out, not just what it's listed for. That's the market I work in every day: Mission Hills, Leawood, Prairie Village, Fairway, Overland Park, Brookside, and the wider Kansas City metro on both sides of the state line.
FROM THE SITE
What Makes the Shakespeare Chateau Singular
Most historic homes have been compromised. Original windows replaced. Period details painted over or removed entirely. The Shakespeare Chateau is the exception that makes you realize how rare genuine architectural integrity actually is. 47 original stained-glass windows. Every single one installed in 1885 and still present.
FROM THE SITE
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Sage Sotheby's International Realty and how is it different from other brokerages? Sage Sotheby's International Realty is the Kansas City and Oklahoma City regional affiliate of Sotheby's International Realty, a global luxury real estate brand with over 1,000 offices in 80+ countries.

OPENING LINE
Kansas City's Dynamic Real Estate Advisor — Experience Results, Strategy, and Fun with Anthony West.
Try another opening line
YOUR INTRODUCTION
With over a decade leading Houses of Kansas City at Sage Sotheby’s International Realty, I bring substantial local expertise and an energetic approach to every transaction. My mantra, ‘Let’s Have Fun & Do Some Business Along the Way,’ reflects both my strategic mindset and genuine passion for connecting people with their ideal homes. My foundation as a Kansas City native and my Jayhawk Business roots shape a service-forward, creative process that ensures your experience is seamless and engaging—from our first conversation to closing day. I’ve represented $34M+ in sales, driven a social media reach of 500K+, and maintained a 98% list-to-sale ratio for my clients. Let’s put your goals at the center of our next adventure.
